home-coaching-banner.png.originalPrompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: an ORIGINAL photographic website hero/banner for MovX, inspired by the ATMOSPHERE and SETTING of the user's attached reference, not a reproduction.
Reference role: mood/setting reference only. Create different fictional adults, clothing, camera composition and background. Do not recreate the exact people, face identities or photograph; do not edit or clean the reference image.

Scene: a relaxed candid moment between ONE adult boxing coach and ONE adult athlete between rounds, in an outdoor rooftop boxing ring at golden hour. The athlete wears ordinary boxing gloves, casually resting one forearm near a ring rope, looking toward the coach with a small warm natural smile. The coach wears a plain muted dark-green training shirt and has attentive friendly posture, talking with the athlete as if giving a simple helpful tip. Show both faces in natural three-quarter views and a waist/upper-body crop, with believable facial features, skin texture, hair and normal body types. Avoid model physiques and artificial perfect smiles. They should seem comfortable with each other, like a real coach and regular client, not posing for a sports advert.
Setting and atmosphere: warm hazy evening sunlight and subtle rim light; neutral muted taupe, cream and forest-green tones; soft shallow depth of field. A believable low-rise European/Berlin-like city rooftop backdrop recedes into creamy photographic bokeh. Flat urban horizon, understated rooftops, no mountains or invented famous landmarks. A couple of ordinary muted off-white / dark-forest ring ropes establish the boxing setting without dominating. No busy gym crowd, flashy equipment, staged high-five, fist-bump or active punch. Focus on human trust and easy conversation after training.
Composition: VERY WIDE SHALLOW horizontal banner, ideally about 5:1. Put the two adults together on the LEFT third/left 40 percent, keeping both heads and upper bodies fully inside the frame with natural breathing room. Give the CENTER and RIGHT 60 percent generous softly blurred warm sky/city negative space for a two-line white website slogan added separately in HTML. The image should feel like one real candid photograph through a portrait lens, not separate subjects pasted onto an AI panorama. Preserve real-looking lens falloff and small imperfections. No glossy skin, excessive sharpening or cinematic orange/teal grading.
No text, lettering, logos, watermarks, graphics or UI. Do not copy the reference's branding, repeated markings, exact poses, identities or skyline. New original scene with the same warm, reassuring coach-athlete atmosphere.
